system.description: When you pass a Performance Check or Crit on any Save, you can cause a Being that can hear you to become Berserk, Charmed, Confused, or Frightened for [[/r Cd{{feature-value:4:2}}]] Rounds. Once this ends, they are immune to this Ability for the Shift. {{feature-value:This countdown die increases to a Cd6 at 8th Level.: }}
